To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

guar gum has stronger effect than locust bean gum on viscosity of Indian yoghurt drinks, and that the optimal lowest viscosity was obtained at the ratio 0.445:0.905 of guar gum and of locust bean gums to 20 g of Indian yoghut powder.
the viscosity of reconstituted dahi powder drink can be optimised by varying the amount of stabilizers added, using central composite design with response surface methodology.
the addition of stabilizers, guar gum and locost bean gum, in the ratio 0.445:0.905 g, respectively, in dahi powder based drink, can significantly reduce its viscosity to 2.003 ± 0.003 Pa-s.
In summary, our research is concerned with
optimising the amount of stabilizer in the reconstituted yoghurt drink to achieve an optimised viscosity.
the optimisation of reconstituted dahi powder based drink, by studying the variation in viscosity of the drink with respect to variation in amount of guar gum, and locust bean gums.

development of an optimised re-constituted Indian dairy drink, with the desired rheological characteristics, which can be prepared at home by adding the appropriate amount of stabilizers to a mixture of dahi powder and water.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the viscosity can be reduced to the desired level by adding the optimum amount of stabilizers.
the viscosity of reconstituted dahi powder based drink could be decreased by addition of guar gum and/or locust bean gum and the amount of guar gum should be more than that of locust bean gums.
the variation of the viscosity of the reconstituted dahi drink can be explained by variation in the amount of guar gum added.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully optimised the viscosity of the drink using response surface methodology and the optimisation has been validated by the experimental data.

, we have successfully developed a model for the optimisation of the reconstituted drink based on the viscosity of the drink, and have successfully developed an optimised drink with the lowest viscosity of 0.003 Pa-s.
, by using response surface methodology, we could optimise the composition of dahi drink to get the lowest possible viscosity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the addition of locust bean and guar gum can be used to control viscosity of dahi drink, and the addition of guar gum is more effective than that of locust bean.
the addition of locust bean and guar gums in dahi powder based drink, helps to improve its viscosity and stability.

, the addition of guar gum and the addition of locust bean gums are important in reducing the viscosity of the drink and that the ratio of the two stabilizers should be kept at a certain level to get the optimum viscosity of the drink.
